system.description:
Heart; 6 Sharp; Close (5 ft). Legendary weapon, linked to the Survivor's Legendary Weapon ability (p74). Only the Worthy: only a character the sword judges worthy can wield it. Cleave: if a Strike kills its target, the unused damage carries over to another enemy of your choice within Close Range (5 ft).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.150
